limitations.note: Instead of correcting the 1-yuan transitions from S1 to S2 and S1_5 to S2_5 in place, the rewrite registered the outputs, counted simultaneous inputs together rather than prioritizing d1, and queued change across cycles.

The test compared the rewrite against a model with the same edge detection, credit arithmetic, and queued-change rules, so passing did not establish that the original FSM’s cycle-by-cycle behavior was preserved.
